messages:
Noor: quick UX sync note — the p95 + heatmap panel: users said the hover popovers are noisy when investigating latency spikes. we need a less obtrusive pattern.
Calvin: heard that. idea: tiny anchor marker in-chart + a non-modal info pill that lives in the panel chrome. keeps focus within the panel.
Mei: for keyboard accessibility, make each marker focusable (`tabindex=0`) and pressing Enter opens the existing detail drawer (not a new modal). same pattern as traces.
Priya: copy suggestion for the pill: 'Low sampling — some short spikes may be hidden'. clicking expands inline micro-controls: slider + 'View raw traces' link.
Noor: visual treatment: 5px dot with 1px white ring on dark tiles; on focus show 3px ring glow. ensure contrast >=4.5:1.
Calvin: implementation note: render dense markers on canvas for perf; create DOM nodes only for visible/focusable markers. hybrid approach.
Mei: A11y nits: pill needs `role=button`, `aria-expanded`, and live region update `aria-live=polite` when state changes. also add skip link to jump to drawer content.
Priya: motion: any fade or pulse must respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Noor: telemetry: track `sampling.pill_opened`, `spike.focused`, and `sampling.adjusted` with panel id. gate sampling rollouts behind experiment flag.
Calvin: small CSS prototype for the marker: ```css
.marker{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--warning-500);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #fff;}
.marker:focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,51,204,0.12);}
.pill{padding:6px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.06);}
```
Mei: will run axe on the mock, watch for focus order and descriptive labels.
Noor: next steps: Priya wire two compact variants (pill-expanded micro-controls vs. drawer anchor), Mei to validate a11y flows, Calvin to confirm perf hybrid, Noor to open telemetry ticket.
Priya: will drop mocks by Tue EOD.
Calvin: perf feasibility check Wed.
Mei: I'll run an a11y pass after prototypes.
AuditBot: checklist added to thread: [focus order, aria labels, prefers-reduced-motion, telemetry events].
Noor: thanks team — we'll review in Thu design sync.
